title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Included Radius, Per-Mile Fee and Service Area
content:
Distance for a Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment is measured in road miles from the delivering club, computed when the appointment is booked and recorded on the appointment. Each service level sets three figures: the road miles included in the base fee, the fee per road mile beyond that included radius, and the farthest delivery address the level serves.

| Service level | Road miles included in the base fee | Fee per road mile beyond the included radius | Farthest delivery address served |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Curbside Delivery | 50 miles | $1.25 a mile | 120 miles |
| Northgate Threshold Delivery | 50 miles | $1.25 a mile | 120 miles |
| Northgate Room of Choice Delivery | 50 miles | $1.50 a mile | 120 miles |
| Northgate White Glove Delivery | 50 miles | $1.50 a mile | 100 miles |
| Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation | 50 miles | $1.50 a mile | 100 miles |
| Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation | 40 miles | $1.50 a mile | 80 miles |

## Notes on the mileage card

- The included radius is 50 road miles at every level except Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation, where it is 40.
- The per-mile fee is $1.25 at the two entry levels, Curbside and Threshold, and $1.50 at the four others.
- The farthest address served narrows from 120 miles at Curbside, Threshold and Room of Choice to 100 miles at White Glove and Appliance Delivery & Installation and 80 miles at TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation.

**Hypothetical distances.** An address 65 road miles from the delivering club lies 15 miles beyond the 50-mile radius of Northgate Room of Choice Delivery and 25 miles beyond the 40-mile radius of Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation. An address exactly 50 road miles away lies no miles beyond a 50-mile radius. An address 90 road miles away is within the farthest distance of White Glove (100 miles) and beyond that of TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation (80 miles).
